Name: Zair
ModernLocation: Unknown; candidates include the Zoar area, Zior, and Mount Seir
Description: Zair was the place to which Joram, king of Israel, went with his chariots against Edom, and where, surrounded by Edomites, he broke through by night to escape.
BiblicalSignificance: Zair is the scene of Joram's narrow escape in the Edomite revolt: a night breakthrough when the army had fled to its tents.
